description: PRD-38.5: Widget Marketplace - Browse, install, rate, and review widgets. Developer dashboard for publishers. Leverages existing plugin marketplace infra. Visual builder and Stripe monetization deferred.

userStories.title: Create marketplace_widgets table via migration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a table for marketplace widget listings.
acceptanceCriteria: Create Alembic migration for marketplace_widgets: id UUID PK, name VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE, display_name VARCHAR(200), description TEXT, long_description TEXT
Add developer_id UUID FK users, developer_name VARCHAR(200), version VARCHAR(20), changelog TEXT
Add pricing_type VARCHAR(20) CHECK IN ('free','one_time','subscription'), price_cents INTEGER, currency VARCHAR(3) DEFAULT 'USD'
Add icon_url TEXT, screenshots JSONB DEFAULT '[]', readme TEXT, keywords TEXT[], categories TEXT[]
Add bundle_url TEXT, bundle_size INTEGER, permissions TEXT[], min_plan VARCHAR(50)
Add install_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, rating_average DECIMAL(3,2) DEFAULT 0, rating_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0
Add status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK IN ('draft','review','published','suspended'), published_at TIMESTAMP
Add indexes on developer_id, status WHERE published
userStories.notes: Created 20260225_create_marketplace_widgets.py with 27 columns, CHECK constraints on pricing_type and status, partial index on published status. Chains from 20260225_sdk_api_keys.

userStories.title: Create widget_installations and widget_reviews tables
userStories.description: As a developer, I need tables for tracking installs and reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: Create widget_installations: id UUID PK, widget_id FK, workspace_id UUID, user_id FK, last_used_at, use_count DEFAULT 0, installed_at, uninstalled_at nullable
Add indexes on widget_id, workspace_id, user_id
Create widget_reviews: id UUID PK, widget_id FK, user_id FK, rating INTEGER CHECK 1-5, title VARCHAR(200), body TEXT
Add is_verified_purchase BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'published'
userStories.notes: Created 20260225_create_widget_installs_reviews.py with both tables, all FKs with CASCADE/SET NULL, CHECK on rating 1-5, UNIQUE on (widget_id, user_id).

userStories.title: Create SQLAlchemy models for marketplace entities
userStories.description: As a developer, I need ORM models for widgets, installations, and reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: Add relationships: widget has many installations and reviews
userStories.notes: Created all 3 models with relationships and cascade delete. Registered in __init__.py. UniqueConstraint on reviews.

userStories.title: Create marketplace browsing API endpoints
userStories.description: As a user, I need endpoints to browse, search, and filter marketplace widgets.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /widgets returns paginated published widgets with search (?q=), category filter, pricing filter, sort (popular/newest/rating), pagination
GET /widgets/:id returns full detail with readme, screenshots, changelog
userStories.notes: Created widget_marketplace.py with 18 total endpoints covering browse, install, review, and publish. Search uses ILIKE, categories use unnest(). Registered in main.py.

userStories.title: Create widget installation API endpoints
userStories.description: As a user, I need endpoints to install, uninstall, and list installed widgets.
userStories.notes: Install/uninstall/list endpoints in widget_marketplace.py. Duplicate prevention returns 409. Install count maintained atomically.

userStories.title: Create widget review API endpoints
userStories.description: As a user, I need endpoints to create, read, update, and delete reviews.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /widgets/:id/reviews returns paginated reviews sorted newest first
POST /widgets/:id/reviews creates review with rating (1-5), title, body
Sets is_verified_purchase if user has active install
Recalculates rating_average and rating_count after changes
userStories.notes: CRUD review endpoints with ownership validation. _recalculate_rating() helper runs after every mutation. Verified purchase auto-detected from active installations.

userStories.title: Create widget publishing API endpoints
userStories.description: As a developer, I need endpoints to submit, update, and manage my widgets.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /widgets creates widget in draft status with current user as developer
PUT /widgets/:id updates (validates ownership, only in draft/published)
POST /widgets/:id/submit moves draft to review (validates required fields)
GET /developer/widgets returns user's widgets with status and stats
GET /developer/analytics returns aggregate: total installs, reviews, avg rating
userStories.notes: Full developer lifecycle in widget_marketplace.py. Draft creation, ownership-validated updates, submit validation, developer analytics, admin approve/suspend with role check.

userStories.title: Seed marketplace with internal widgets
userStories.description: As a user, I want pre-populated widgets so the marketplace isn't empty.
acceptanceCriteria: Create seed script inserting 8+ internal widgets as published
Widgets: Chat Assistant, Data Explorer, Document Viewer, Code Inspector, Email Manager, Terminal, Workflow Monitor, Memory Inspector
Each has icon_url, description, categories, permissions, pricing_type=free, readme
Developer name set to Automatos AI
userStories.notes: Created scripts/seed_marketplace_widgets.py with 8 widgets, all free, published, with markdown readmes. Idempotent via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Realistic install counts and ratings.

userStories.title: Build marketplace home page
userStories.description: As a user, I want a marketplace page to discover widgets with search and categories.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget grid with sort dropdown (Popular, Newest, Highest Rated)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created 455-line page with debounced search, horizontal featured scroll with nav buttons, category chips from API, sort dropdown, WidgetGrid, pagination, and skeleton loading states.

userStories.title: Build WidgetCard and WidgetGrid components
userStories.description: As a frontend developer, I need reusable marketplace card and grid components.
acceptanceCriteria: Create frontend/components/marketplace/WidgetCard.tsx: icon, name, developer, description (2 lines), rating stars, install count, price badge
Card links to detail page on click
Create WidgetGrid.tsx: responsive grid (3 cols desktop, 2 tablet, 1 mobile)
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: WidgetCard matches existing MarketplaceCard pattern with glass-card styling. RatingStars component, formatted install count, price badge. WidgetGrid with responsive 1/2/3 column grid and empty state.

userStories.title: Build widget detail page
userStories.description: As a user, I want a detail page with full info, screenshots, reviews, and install button.
acceptanceCriteria: Header: icon, name, developer, rating, install count
Sidebar: developer, categories, version, size, published date
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created 493-line detail page with header, install toggle, 4 tabs (overview with sanitized HTML, screenshot gallery, reviews with inline form, changelog), and info sidebar.

userStories.title: Build review components
userStories.description: As a user, I want to read and write reviews for widgets.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ReviewList.tsx: paginated reviews with avatar, stars, title, body, date, verified badge
Create ReviewForm.tsx: star selector, title, body, submit
Form shows only if installed and not yet reviewed
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: ReviewList with glass-card reviews, verified badge, pagination. ReviewForm with interactive star selector, hover preview, validation. Conditional rendering based on isInstalled and existingReview.

userStories.title: Build developer dashboard page
userStories.description: As a widget developer, I want a dashboard showing my widgets and metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: Stats cards: Published Widgets, Total Installs, Average Rating, Total Reviews
My Widgets table: name, version, status badge, installs, rating, actions
Create Widget button linking to publish
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Created developer page with 4 stats cards, widgets table with color-coded status badges, edit/view actions, empty state CTA, and Create Widget button in header.

userStories.title: Build widget publish wizard
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a multi-step form to submit my widget.
acceptanceCriteria: Step 5: review all fields, Submit for Review button
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: 5-step wizard with progress indicator, per-step validation, auto-save draft after step 1, PUT updates on subsequent steps. Submit for review button on step 5. Success confirmation.

userStories.title: Add Widget Marketplace link to main navigation
userStories.description: As a user, I want marketplace access from the sidebar.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Widget Marketplace link to sidebar with store icon from lucide-react
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Added Puzzle icon import and Widget Marketplace nav entry to sidebar.tsx after Community Marketplace. Links to /marketplace/widgets with info color.
